g.text: Fast. The Windows app opens a PDF in about 0.2 s and needs about 22 MB of RAM with one document open
Private. Documents are rendered on your device. PrayDF uploads nothing and has no telemetry.
Familiar. A dark, Chrome-style viewer: page thumbnails, type a page number, zoom, fit to width or page,
Open. MIT licensed and built on proven engines: pdf.js, mammoth and PDFium.
